༄༅// de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can ma'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo badzra dha rā nanda ni rā bho gā ya/ rgyal ba gtsug tor rnam par lta ba'i ting nge 'dzin// chu gter snyoms zhugs gtsug tor mthon mthing lhun po'i phrag /nyer 'phos dpa' mo zhal phyag stong ma'i rgyu skar bdag /bla ma srid zhi'i 'jigs pa'i gdung skyob can la 'dud// tshad med thugs rje nus pa'i skyabs sbyin brkyangs pa'i 'og /'du ba rnam bzhi'i bro dang gdon bgegs kyis gtses sam// 'khor ba mya ngan las 'das 'jigs dang rgud pa rnams// snang dang mun ltar skad cig 'jil la 'di rmad byung*// ye shes rnam lnga'i rang gzugs zlos pa bcu bdun lhas// rnam par rtsen pa byang chub phyogs kyi chos gzugs dngos// thar pa'i grong khyer rmad byung gang du skal ba can// mngon par bcug ste dbang rab bskur ba'i cho ga bshad// de la 'dir bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can ma'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ mjug gi cho ga ste gsum las/ dang po rdul tshon phyogs ltar na// sa chog spyi ltar byas pa'i sar// skya thig legs par btab pa'i steng*// ras bris yin na stegs kyi khar// maṇḍal dri yi thig le dang*// me tog tshom bu bcu bdun bkod// de mthar dbang ldan mtshams 'dzin nas// brtsams te chu gnyis nyer spyod rnams// g.yas skor phyogs bzhi shar bcas par// spos dang mar me zhal zas lnga// 'og tu sa lha'i tshom bu dang*// gtor ma sgos mchod rnams kyang bshams// dbang ldan nas brtsams shar lho'i bar// gtor ma rgyas pa zhe gsum mam// zlum gtor lnga dang dmar gtor gcig /gzhi bdag dkar gtor lho phyogs nas// cha gsum dkyil 'khor spyi ltar bsham// logs su sngon 'gro dkar dmar gnyis// slob dpon mdun du rdo rje dril// bum pa gnyis la nang bcud dang*// kha rgyan mchod yon gzungs rdor bcas// ras bzang mgul chings prog lnga'am// bdun pa legs bcings mtshan ma gdags// gtsang ma chu yis sum gnyis dgang*// logs su slob ma sta gon chas// nyer spyod so shing khyor chu dang*// srung skud ku sha sogs bsham mo// cho ga dngos la sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/

dang po la bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i bya ba/ rjes kyi cho ga ste gsum las/ dang po dkyil 'khor gyi sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma bshams/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar la 'di skad do// oṃ dus gsum bde gshegs sprul pa'i sku// gzhan gyis mi thub drug shul che// gtum pa chen mo stobs chen mo// 'bar ba chen mo gzi brjid che// dkar mo chen mo stobs chen mo// 'bar ba'i phreng ba gos dkar mo// 'phags pa sgrol ma khro gnyer can// rgyal ba'i rdo rje phreng zhes grags// padma'i mngon mtshan rdo rje'i mtshan// gzhan gyis mi thub phreng ba can// rdo rje mkhar bsnams 'joms pa mo// zhi ba'i lha rnams kyis mchod ma// gzugs zhi gzi brjid chen mo can// 'phags ma sgrol ma stobs chen mo// rdo rje lu gu rgyud gzhan dang*// rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin ma// lag na rdo rje rigs gser phreng*// le brgan rtsi dang rin chen ma// snang mdzad rdo rje'i gtsug tor grags// rnam par bsgyings ma'i rdo rje dang*// gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' ma// rdo rje'i 'gros dang dkar mo dang*// padma'i spyan dang zla 'od dang*// phyag rgya'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod/ de nas rang phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis/ gtor ma oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi swā hā zhes pa lan gsum gyis bsngos la/

spos dang bcas te thal mo sbyar la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun gyi byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams dang*/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa kun la sbyar te/ 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa rnams la/ rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams la/ phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la/ 'jig rten na yang dag par song ba rnams la/ yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la/ lha'i drang srong dmod pa 'dor ba phan 'dogs nus pa rnams la/ rig sngags 'chang grub pa rnams la/ tshangs pa la/ dbang po la/ legs ldan drag po dka' thub bzlog pa'i bdag po dang lhan cig pa rnams la/ legs ldan sred med kyi bu phyag rgya chen po lngas phyag byas pa la/ legs ldan nag po chen po grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig par byed pa dur khrod na gnas par mos pa ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung la/ padma'i gdung la/ rdo rje'i gdung la/ nor bu'i gdung la/ glang po'i gdung la/ gzhon nu'i gdung la/ klu'i gdung la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon cha'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla baiḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sā la'i dbang po'i me tog kun du rgyas pa la/

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che tog gi rgyal po la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan rgyas pa utpa la'i bsung gi tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhes bya ba phyir bzlog pa chen mo 'dis 'byung po'i gdon thams cad tshar gcod pa/ gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad gcod pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba las bzlog pa/ sems can gsod pa dang bcings pa thams cad las dgrol ba/ sdang ba dang rmi lam ngan pa dang ltas ngan pa thams cad bzlog pa/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gdon thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ gdon stong phrag brgyad khri bzhi stong 'jigs par byed pa/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dga' bar byed pa/ gza' chen po brgyad 'jigs par byed pa/ dgra thams cad bzlog pa/ ma rungs pa dang sdang ba dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ dug dang mtshon dang me dang chu las sgrol ba ste/ rig sngags kyi cho ga 'di sbyar bar bya'o// ming 'di zhes bya ba la rig sngags 'di 'grub par gyur cig swā hā/ 'byung po'i tshogs gang su dag sa la rgyu ba rnams dang*/ nam mkha' la rgyu ba rnams dang*/ chu la rgyu ba rnams dang*/ lha rnams dang*/ klu rnams dang*/ lha ma yin rnams dang*/ rlung lha rnams dang*/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang*/ dri za rnams dang*/ mi'am ci rnams dang*/

lto 'phye chen po rnams dang*/ gnod sbyin rnams dang*/ srin po rnams dang*/ yi dwags rnams dang*/ sha za rnams dang*/ 'byung po rnams dang*/ grul bum rnams dang*/ srul po rnams dang*/ lus srul po rnams dang*/ skem byed rnams dang*/ smyo byed rnams dang*/ brjed byed rnams dang*/ grib gnon rnams dang*/ rnon po rnams bdag la nyon cig 'byung po'i tshogs gzi brjid 'phrog pa rnams dang*/ mdangs 'phrog pa rnams dang*/ zas su mngal za ba rnams dang*/ zas su khrag 'thung ba rnams dang*/ zas su zhag za ba rnams dang*/ zas su sha za ba rnams dang*/ zas su tshil za ba rnams dang*/ zas su rkang za ba rnams dang*/ zas su btsas pa za ba rnams dang*/ srog 'phrog pa rnams dang*/ zas su gtor ma za ba rnams dang*/ zas su phreng ba za ba rnams dang*/ zas su dri za ba rnams dang*/ zas su bdug pa za ba rnams dang*/ zas su me tog za ba rnams dang*/ zas su 'bras bu za ba rnams dang*/ zas su lo tog za ba rnams dang*/ zas su sbyin sreg za ba rnams dang*/ zas su rnag za ba rnams dang*/ zas su phyi sa za ba rnams dang*/ zas su gcin 'thung ba rnams dang*/ zas su lhag ma za ba rnams dang*/ zas su mchil ma za ba rnams dang*/ zas su ngar snabs za ba rnams dang*/ zas su mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang*/ zas su skyug pa za ba rnams dang*/ zas su stor khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba rnams dang*/ sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams bdag la nyon cig rig sngags chen mo 'di bsgrub par bya'o// spos dang me tog dang bdug pa dang gtor ma yang sbyin no// gtor ma dang mchod pa 'di bzhes nas mgu bar gyis la/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/

gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams dang*/ gzi brjid 'phrog pa'i gdon thams cad dengs shig ces brjod la rol mo drag po bya'o// gu gul gyi dud pas bdug cing thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags dang gtso mo'i sngags dang a mṛ ta brjod cing gtor ma phyi rol du dor ro// de nas mtshams gcad par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma chen mo'i bkas ming 'di zhes bya ba la sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ lha'i gdon rnams dang*/ klu'i gdon rnams dang*/ lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang*/ rlung lha'i gdon rnams dang*/ nam mkha' lding gi gdon rnams dang*/ dri za'i gdon rnams dang*/ mi'am ci'i gdon rnams dang*/ lto 'phye chen po'i gdon rnams dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang*/ srin po'i gdon rnams dang*/ yi dwags kyi gdon rnams dang*/ sha za'i gdon rnams dang*/ 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang*/ grul bum gyi gdon rnams dang*/ srul po'i gdon rnams dang*/ lus srul po'i gdon rnams dang*/ skem byed kyi gdon rnams dang*/ smyo byed kyi gdon rnams dang*/ grib gnon gyi gdon rnams dang*/ brjed byed kyi gdon rnams dang*/ gnon po'i gdon rnams dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon rnams dang*/ nam gru'i gdon rnams dang*/ gshin rje'i gdon rnams dang*/ bya'i gdon rnams dang*/ ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon rnams dang*/ kun du 'gro ba'i gdon rnams dang*/ re lde 'don pa'i gdon rnams dang*/ tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon rnams dang*/ rims nyin gcig pa rnams dang*/ nyin gnyis pa rnams dang*/ nyin gsum pa rnams dang*/ nyin bzhi pa rnams dang*/ nyin bdun pa rnams dang*/ rtag pa'i rims rnams dang*/ rims mi bzad pa rnams dang*/

rims ldang dub pa dang*/ 'byung po'i rims rnams dang*/ rlung las gyur pa dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa dang*/ bad kan las gyur pa dang*/ 'dus pa las gyur pa dang*/ rims nad thams cad dang*/ klad pa na ba dang*/ gzhogs phyed na ba dang*/ yi ga 'chus pa dang*/ mig nad dang*/ sna nad dang*/ kha nad dang*/ mgul nad dang*/ snying nad dang*/ lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang*/ rna ba na ba dang*/ so na ba dang*/ rtsib logs na ba dang*/ rgyab na ba dang*/ lto ba na ba dang*/ rked pa na ba dang*/ chu so na ba dang*/ brla na ba dang*/ rje ngar na ba dang*/ lag pa na ba dang*/ rkang pa na ba dang*/ yan lag na ba dang*/ nying lag na ba dang*/ rims dang*/ shu ba dang*/ g.ya' ba dang*/ 'brum bu phra mo dang*/ mtshan bar rdol ba dang*/ mdze dang*/ phol mig dang*/ bas ldags dang*/ me dbal dang*/ g.yan pa dang*/ lhog pa dang*/ skems pa dang*/ skrag pa dang*/ lud pa lu ba dang*/ dbugs mi bde ba dang*/ mi dran pa dang*/ dbyig dug dang*/ dug sbyar ma dang*/ byad dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ mi ngas dang*/ dgra dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/ gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa thams cad kyi rig sngags bcing bar bgyi'o// gzi brjid dbrog par bgyi'o// gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad gcad par bgyi'o// gdon thams cad bzlog par bgyi'o// gnod pa thams cad las bsrung bar bgyi'o// gdugs dkar po can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog pa chen mo 'dis dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi nang tshun chad du gnod pa thams cad bsrung bar bgyi'o// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la bsrung du gsol/ lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig swā hā/ oṃ ṣṭoṃ bandha baddha badzra ma ma rakṣa rakṣa badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod do// de nas mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon zhes pa nas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur par bsams la oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs nas shabda swā hā'i bar so so'i phyag rgya dang*/

dharmā ra ṇi sogs dang rol mor bcas pas byin dbab bo// de nas bdag gi rnal 'byor la sngon 'gro tshogs bsags pa dang*/ dngos gzhi lha bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar byas/ rang nyid skad cig gis gdugs dkar po can du gsal ba'i snying ga'i dbus su padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ dri ma med pa'i shel ltar dkar zhing gsal ba'i oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas lus thams cad gang*/ thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyi rol du 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ 'od kyi snang ba des rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can ma'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can// zhal stong thugs rje'i spyan dang ldan// phyag stong 'jigs pa kun las skyob// gtsug tor las byung khyod phyag 'tshal// gzhan gyis mi thub dbus dang gzhan// phyogs mtshams grwa sgo bzhi bzhi ru// bzhugs nas tha dad las mdzad ma// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la bstod// gdung bdun de bzhin gshegs pa bcu// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams dang*// legs ldan mched gsum 'khor dang bcas// drang srong rig 'dzin grub rnams la// lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag bya/ so so'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas shabda pra tītstsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs kyi rgyun bshags lan gsum byas la/ oṃ badzra muḥzhes pas tshogs rten rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ tshad med bzhi spyi ltar bsgom/

oṃ swā bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du bsgoms pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems nyid yi ge oṃ dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus oṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can ma sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon pas bdag nyid yul 'khor srid 'bangs dang bcas pa khebs pa'i gdugs dkar po bsnams pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa zhes phyag gnyis ma bskyed pa'am/ yang na zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar po zhi ba'i zhal/ g.yas zhal sngon po drag po'i zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gdugs dkar po rin po che'i tog gis spras pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa na rdo rje/ gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa na lcags kyu/ g.yon gyi dang pos rin po che'i rgyal mtshan/ gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs gsol ba/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ ma rungs pa thams cad 'jigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ zhes phyag brgyad ma bsgom pa'am/ yang na rgyas pa la dga' bas 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i gsung rab las 'byung ba dang*/ snye mdo shākya dpal ba la sogs pas bdag bskyed kyi skabs su'ang gzhan gyis mi thub ma bcas zhal phyag rdzogs par bskyed par bshad pa ltar na/

sngar gyi sa bon gyi skabs/ tshur 'dus oṃ la thim zhes pa'i rjes su/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo dkar po lte ba la oṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ de las kyang 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ khyad par 'jigs par byed pa'i gdon dang mdangs 'phrog par byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas la thim pas yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa chen mo/ sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ rtsa zhal nyis brgya snying rje dang zhi ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas zhal gnyis brgya sgeg pa dang dpa' ba'i zhal ser po/ rgyab zhal nyis brgya dgod pa dang drag shul gyi zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal nyis brgya rngams pa dang nyams sna tshogs pa'i zhal ljang gu/ steng zhal nyis brgya mi sdug pa dang 'jigs su rung ba'i zhal sngon po/ zhal re re la nyams sna tshogs pa'i spyan gsum gsum gyis mtshan pa/ zhal la la bzhad pa/ la la mche ba gtsigs pa/ la la rab tu gdangs pa/ la la ljags 'dril zhing ha ha zhes drag tu bzhad pa/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin/ g.yas 'og ma rnams na 'khor lo dgu bcu go dgu/ rdo rje brgya/ rin po che brgya/ padma brgya/ sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba brgya bsnams pa'o// g.yon gyi dang pos mda' dang bcas pa'i gdugs dkar po rin po che'i tog gis spras pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon 'og ma rnams na mda' dgu bcu go dgu/ gzhu brgya/ lcags kyu brgya/ zhags pa brgya/ ral gri 'bar ba brgya bsnams pa'o// zhabs g.yas lnga brgya bskum zhing*/ g.yon lnga brgya brkyangs pas 'jigs par byed pa'i gdon thams cad dang*/ mdangs 'phrog pa'i gdon thams cad dang*/ ma rungs pa'i gdon thams cad mnan pa/

sku la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos bzang po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs gsol ba/ sku'i cha thams cad las 'dzum pa dang*/ zur gyis blta ba dang*/ rnam par bgrad pa dang*/ glog ltar 'gyu ba la sogs pa'i spyan bye ba brgya stong mang pos ma rungs pa thams cad 'jigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ spyi gtsug na mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags su khro bo'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa me 'od rab tu 'bar bas mtshan pa/ 'phags pa thams cad la mchod pa dang*/ sdug bsngal can rnams la skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang*/ ma rungs pa rnams zil gyis gnon pa ste 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phro ba'i dbus na gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o// de'i thugs kar paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i zhal phyag rdzogs par bsgom pa ste/ de gsum gang mos re bsgoms nas/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i stod du oṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan drangs la/ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing*/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ de la mtshan sngags re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi sku yi rigs las byung*// gangs ri ltar dkar zhal gsum phyag brgyad mnga'// dar dang rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// mi mthun phyogs 'joms khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa tsam mam/ rigs gsum bsdus phyir dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal// bar chad zhi zhing gdon bgegs drag po 'dul// khams gsum brtan g.yo ma lus dbang du sdud// phrin las sna tshogs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'khor lo rdo rje dang*// mda' gzhu lcags kyu zhags pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// gzhan gyi sbyor ngan dgra dang gnod byed bgegs// tshar gcod rjes su 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod la/ lha sku me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam/ dbang po'i gzhu lta bu la yid rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag par bya'o// shes pa 'phro na sngags kyi bzlas pa la 'jug ste/ lha mo'i thugs ka'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng oṃ gyi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du bkod pa las las dang mthun pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don byas/ khyad par gdug pa can rnams tshar gcad par bsam zhing*/ tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ kha sa me kha sa me/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ sarba buddha a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭhi te/ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ ma ma hūm̐ ni swā hā/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas pa ni bsnyen pa'i sngags so// las kyi sngags ni gzungs ring ste/ de zlo bar 'dod pas rang gi sku'i cha las 'phros pa'i khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs mtshon cha du ma thogs pa dpag tu med pas pha rol gyi rig sngags kyi zhags pa thams cad bcad/ rig sngags sbyor ba po dang zlo ba po phur bus btab pa dang mnan par bsam zhing*/

oṃ si tā na lārka pra bhā sphu ṭa bi ka si tā ta pa tre/ dzwa la dzwa la/ khā da khā da/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ dha ra dha ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ tshindha tshindha/ bhinda bhinda hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ he he phaṭa/ ho ho phaṭa/ a mo ghā ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha tā ya phaṭa/ wa ra dā ya phaṭa/ wa ra pra dā ya phaṭa/ pra tyaṃ gi rā ya phaṭa/ ces pa bzla'o// bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ bdag bskyed

shākya dpal gyis ma bshad kyang 'gro mgon 'phags pas bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa dbyung bar bshad pa rgyud gzhung gi bzhed par 'thad che ba ltar byas/ kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams la/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol zhes 'dod don zhus la yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol te/ oṃ badzra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol la/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o// bdag bskyed rkyang pa nyams su len na skyabs 'gro nas 'di'i bar bya zhing dge ba bsngo'o// gnyis pa la bzhi las/ dang po sa lha sta gon ni/ tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ baṃ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhi ba'i cha lugs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis bklubs pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa thugs kar bzung ba/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du hūm̐ bsams la hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/

mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ spos dang bcas te rdo rje dril bu thogs nas mkhyen par gsol ba ni/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang*// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng gi skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi stobs// pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba 'tshal na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod pas/ des kyang rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsams la/ lag pa g.yas sa la reg ste/ oṃ badzra muḥsa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim par bsam mo// gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bskyed la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre nā ma/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa chen mo/ sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po sogs nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar dang*/ dzi ma hā tsaṇḍa lī nā ma/ padma'i 'dab ma brgyad kyi gdan la shar du gtum pa chen mo/ st+wāṃ ma hā dzwa lā nā ma/

lhor 'bar ba chen mo/ moṃ ma hā gau rī nā ma/ nub tu dkar mo chen mo/ laṃ tā rā nā ma/ byang du sgrol ma/ baṃ dzi na ba dzri nī nā ma/ byang shar du gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ paṃ padmā bhi lakṣa ṇā nā ma/ shar lhor padma'i mngon mtshan can/ saṃ a pa rā dzi tā nā ma/ lho nub tu gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ saṃ badzrauṣṭhī nī nā ma/ nub byang du rdo rje mchu can ma/ dhaṃ shānta de wī nā ma/ de'i phyi rol gyi grwa bzhi'i byang shar du zhi ba'i lha mo/ paṃ shānta ka na ka mā lī nī nā ma/ shar lhor zhi ba gser phreng can/ āṃ ma hā gau rī dzwa lā nā ma/ lho nub tu dkar chen 'bar ma/ gaṃ āryā tā rā nā ma/ nub byang du 'phags ma sgrol ma/ saṃ badzra pa rampa ra ṇī nā ma/ shar sgor rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma/ tsaṃ badzra kau mā rī nā ma/ lho sgor rdo rje gzhon nu ma/ oṃ badzra pā ṇī nā ma/ nub sgor lag na rdo rje ma/ oṃ ratna badzri nī nā ma/ byang sgor rin chen rdo rje ma ljang gu sogs so so'i sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs rnams 'og gi dngos gzhi'i skabs ltar dang*/ phyi'i khor yug gi 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa bskyed nas/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ sogs nas khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa re res dbur brgyan pa'i bar 'og mdun bskyed kyi skabs ltar byas la/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ mchod pa 'bul ba dang bstod pa rnams byas la/ de nas lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i spos bzung*/ g.yon dril bu bcad gtubs su dkrol zhing*/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar lha mo mchog /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor ni// mgon po 'dri bar 'tshal lags na// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// bcom ldan 'das ma bdag ni gus// des na bka' drin mdzad par rigs// 'gro ba 'khor lo bya don gsol// sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs// byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*// gang yang gsang sngags lha rnams dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba ma lus dang*// 'byung po byang chub nye bar gnas// gang dag rdo rje'i spyan mnga' ba'i// bstan la mngon par dga' ba kun// bdag ni rdo rje che ge ste// 'phags ma gdugs dkar dkyil 'khor ni// 'gro ba'i don phyir 'dri lags na// thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs su gsol// deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la// dkyil 'khor lhan cig gyur pa kun// nye ba ru ni mdzad par rigs// lan gsum gyis snyan gsan dbab/

rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo// de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma nas bgegs gtor gyi bar dngos gzhi'i skabs ji lta ba bzhin bya'o// gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ legs par bshams pa'i bum pa gnyis bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ oṃ tapte tapte ma hā tapte swā hā/ lha'i chu dang bcud kyis bkang ba/ oṃ kalpa bṛkṣā ya swā hā/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ chu'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar seng ges bteg pa'i khri padma dang zla ba'i gdan 'dab ma brgyad la nyi ma dang*/ phyi'i mtshams bzhir padma dang zla ba/ phyogs bzhir padma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du oṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros sogs nas thugs kar gzhan gyis mi thub ma bcas pa bskyed pa nas brtsams te/ lha mo thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can no// zhes pa'i bar gyis gtso 'khor bcu bdun mdun bskyed kyi skabs ltar dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum par padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ cung zad khro ba'i nyams can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ sogs nas rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can lha bcu bdun bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥm lus sems can sogs shlau ka gsum sngags dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod pa nas gtso 'khor thams cad la rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa'i khyad par tsam ma gtogs gzhan thams cad mdun bskyed ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bya'o// mtshan sngags re re'i sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa dang*/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar zhes sogs dang*/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma sogs dang 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs shlau ka res bstod/ gzungs thag nas bzung la/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng la phog pas/ de rnams dang lha rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ tadya thā/ a na le sogs bsnyen sngags ci nus dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ bcom ldan 'das ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i sngags so// oṃ dzambha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ gtum pa chen mo'i 'o// oṃ stambha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ 'bar ba chen mo'i 'o// oṃ mo ha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ gos dkar mo'i 'o// oṃ lambha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ sgrol ma'i 'o// oṃ ba ha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ rgyal ba'i rdo rje ma'i 'o// oṃ pa ra bi ṣa saṃ bhakṣa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ padma'i mngon mtshan ma'i 'o// oṃ sarba duṣṭān pra duṣṭā nāṃ stambha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i 'o// oṃ sarba yakṣa rākṣa sa gra hā ṇāṃ bi dhwansan ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/

rdo rje mchu can ma'i 'o// oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ druṃ/ zhi ba chen mo'i 'o// oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ druṃ/ zhi ba gser phreng ma'i 'o// oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ druṃ/ dkar chen ma'i 'o// oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ druṃ/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i 'o// oṃ sarba pa rā bi dyā tstshe da na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma'i 'o// oṃ tsa tu ra shī tī nāṃ gra ha sa ha srā ṇāṃ bi dhwansa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ rdo rje gzhon nu ma'i 'o// oṃ aṣṭā biṃ sha tī nāṃ nakṣa tra pra sā da na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ lag na rdo rje ma'i 'o// oṃ aṣṭā nāṃ ma hā gra hā nāṃ bidhwansa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ rdo rje rin chen ma'i sngags te de rnams ci nus re dang*/ las bum la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa nyer gcig tsam bzlas mthar mchod bstod gong bzhin dang 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul/ las bum la bum pa'i chu kha rgyan gyis 'thor zhing*/ dbang gi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod de/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba bum pa'i chur gyur par bsam mo// bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bcad de/ dbang gi snod du rung ba'i slob ma gcig nas nyer lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa rnams khrus byas nas gral du 'khod pa la/ me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni rang re rnams kyi ston pa tshad med pa'i thugs rje mnga' ba bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang pos gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang mthun par chos kyi rnam grangs dpag tu med par gsungs pa rnams phyogs ris su bsdu na rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/

'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las/ 'dir sngags kyi theg pa'i nang tshan rig sngags 'chang gi sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la'ang bya ba spyi dang so so'i rgyud gnyis las phyi ma ste/ de la rgyud sde'i dbye sgo drug tu yod pa las/ 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud yin/ de la'ang rigs kyi gtso bo/ rigs kyi bdag po/ rigs kyi yum/ rigs kyi gtsug tor/ rigs kyi khro bo khro mo/ rigs kyi pho nya pho mo/ rigs kyi sems dpa'/ rigs kyi gnas gtsang ste brgyad las 'dir rigs kyi gtsug tor 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir bzlog pa chen mo mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi rgyal po paṇḍi ta chen po shū raṃ ga warma dang*/ slob dpon ghi ri wa ta dang*/ bi ma la mi tra sogs kyis legs par bkral ba gtsug tor gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba sgrub pa la/ sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga gnyis las/ dang po la slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro ba'i sa lha dang*/ lha dang*/ bum pa sta gon rnams dgos pa legs par grub nas/ da khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma sta gon la/ chos bcu gsum yod pa las/ dang po lus kyi bya ba khrus byas/ phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul nas rang rang gi gral la snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas 'khod de/ slob dpon la bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar po can dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed du gzhug pa ni/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// zhes sogs nas/ 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// ces gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i skabs kyi don/

tshe 'dir tshe ring ba dang*/ phyi mar lha mi'i go 'phang tsam dang*/ 'khor ba spang ba'i nyan rang tsam don du gnyer ba'i sgo nas ma yin par gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i slad du dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs la dbang blangs te dam tshig la bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pa mdzod/ bsam pa de lta bu zhig skyes na tshe 'di'i nad gdon zhi ba dang*/ phyi mar lha mi'i go 'phang la sogs pa zhar byung du 'byung ba yin no// khyad par can gyi don zhu ba'i slad du bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can gnyis su med par bzhugs pa la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig rnams bdag la stsal du gsol snyam pas/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam la spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// zhes sogs nas/ bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ de la bu zhes nye tshig gis bos te/ khyed rnams chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i theg chen gyi chos kyi snod yin la/ theg chen la yang rgyu 'bras gnyis las/ mchog tu gyur pa rdo rje theg pa kho bos khyod la bstan par bya ste/ rdo rje theg pa 'di ni spyir dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin zhing*/ khyad par du yang 'o skol rnams kyi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po 'di nyid bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du sngags kyi lam la brten nas bdud btul zhing*/ 'og min du sangs rgyas su zin kyang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams drang ba'i phyir du slar dzambu'i gling 'dir 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa yin pas chos kyi bur gyur pa khyed rnams sngags kyi theg pa las blo gzhan du mi 'gyur ba gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/

rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can gyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par mos pa byas/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug gi dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba bgyis pa de dag thams cad so sor bshags shing yang mi bgyid do// zhes lan gsum/ 'khor 'das kun gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la dga' zhing phrag dog med par rjes su yi rang ba bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i zhes pa nas dgongs su gsol/ so so skye bo dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o zhes lan gsum/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi mdzad pa de dag la/ sems can gyi don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba gdab par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

phyogs bcu na nas dgongs su gsol/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sras dang bcas pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi mdzad pa de dag la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba 'debs so// zhes lan gsum/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa de dag mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na nas dgongs su gsol/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa de dag yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so// zhes lan gsum/ rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la dus da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ de'i bslab pa la slob snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na nas dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na nas dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba'i bgyi ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir/

dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ji ltar byang chub chen por smon pa'i sems bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sems bskyed par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis smon pa sems bskyed/ de'i ched du sems can gyi don rgya chen po sgrub cing rdo rje theg pa'i thabs tshul rnams la rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na nas dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas 'das pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byang chub kyi spyod pa la ji ltar bslabs pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ji ltar slob par 'gyur ba dang*/ da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ji ltar slob pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bslab pa la bslab par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis 'jug pa sems bskyed/ smon 'jug brtan pa'i phyir du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// zhes pa nas/ so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang*// kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te// de dag gis ni rjes su bdag slob cing*// dge ba 'di dag thams cad yongs su bsngo// zhes lan gsum gyis rgyud dag par byas nas/ sems bskyed pa'i slob ma la bar chad bsrung ba'i slad du las bum gyi chus gtor te/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas bar du gcod pa dang sdig sgrib rnams sbyangs par mos nas/ byin gyis brlab pa'i slad du khyed rang rnams skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon pas bdag nyid yul 'khor srid 'bangs dang bcas pa khebs pa'i gdugs dkar po bsnams pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i sku can du gsal ba la slob dpon gyis dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pas gnas gsum du reg ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams lam gyis byung bar mos pa mdzod/ de ltar lus ngag yid gsum lha'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa de mchod pa'i yul du bzang ba yin pas/ slob dpon gyis me tog dbu la phul nas mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ bdug spos shangs la/ dhu pe/ mar me spyan lam du/ ā lo ke thugs kar dri'i byug pa/ gandhe/ zhes pas mchod nas/ dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i slad du song shing sbyin pa ni/ bum chus gtor zhing*/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog gi cod paṇa dang bcas pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥdzi hwa saṃ wardha ni swā hā/ zhes pas bsngags pa'i so shing de nyid khyed rnams kyi phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du dngos grub kyi mtshan ma brtag pa'i slad du byin par mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ sngags de nyid kyis byin te/ so drud pa bzhin byas pas sdig sgrib thams cad skyugs par mos la/ so shing gi rwa ba tshom bu dgu bkod pa'i dbus su oṃ badzra ha sa haṃ zhes gsung zhing thal mo kha phye ste ltos pa med par dor cig de ltar dor ba'i rtse mo rang ngam steng du phyogs na mchog gi dngos grub/

shar du phyogs na zhi ba/ lhor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du rgyas pa/ mtshams rnams su phyogs na bum pa bzang po la sogs pa'i dngos grub phran tshegs re dang*/ 'og tu phyogs na sa 'og gi dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ro// sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyang ba'i slad du khyor chu blud pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥbi shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ nishtsa sya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐ zhes bzlas pa'i chu oṃ hrīḥbi shuddha'i sngags kyis lan gsum sbyin no// bar chad bsrung ba'i slad du srung skud sbyin pa ni/ srung skud la bum chus gtor zhing*/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bu dmar po rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi lus tshad dang mnyam pa sum bsgril du byas pa rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi bar chad srung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs spyan drangs te dam tshig gi srad bu la thim zhes dang*/ oṃ a si ta sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ slob ma skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas par gtso bo'i sngags bzla zhing bcing*/ bum chus gtor/ sarba buddhā mai tri rakṣa rakṣa sarbantu swā hā/ sarba buddhā a ddhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ dha ra ka sya rakṣa rakṣa ku ru ku ru swā hā/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes brjod do// rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa dang mal stan lhag par gnas par bya ba'i phyir rtsa ku sha'i sngas stan sbyin pa ni/ ku sha'i phon po che chung gnyis bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dhīḥdang ha las byung ba'i ku sha che chung gnyis rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrug pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur ces dang*/

dhīḥha bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ ku sha chung ba g.yas su dhīḥdang che ba g.yon du ha bzlas pas byin no// chos zab mo bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /ces sogs brjod de/ de'i don ni/ 'jig rten na u dum wā ra'i me tog dkon pa ltar sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byon pa dang*/ byon nas chos gsungs pa dang gsungs pa'i bstan pa gnas pa dang bstan pa'i rjes su bdag gzhan 'jug pa yod pa rnams dkon/ de'i nang nas kyang gsang sngags kyi theg pa dang mjal ba shin tu dkon no// dkon pa de yang phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs te dbang blangs nas dam tshig la bsrung bsdam dang lam la 'bad pa byas na brtson 'grus dang bstun pa'i bye brag gis tshe 'di 'am bar do'am skye ba bdun nam/ bcu drug tshun chad na 'bras bu 'grub par gsungs pas/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu la nye zhing gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu tshe 'dir tshe ring ba dang nad dang sdug bsngal zhi ba la sogs pa'ang rtsol sgrub logs nas mi dgos par zhar las 'byung ba'i tshul gyis 'grub pa yin pas rnyed par dka' la phan yon che ba'i gsang sngags kyi theg pa dang mjal ba 'di skal ba bzang ba yin snyam du shes pa'i sgo nas lam la 'bad pa dang*/ dam tshig la bsrung bsdam tshul bzhin du bgyi snyam pa gyis/ rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ni/ do nub nyal ba'i tshe sngar gyi ku sha chung ba sngas dang*/ che ba stan du gyis la lha dang bla ma yid la dran pa'i sgo nas mgo bo shar ram byang du stan la nyol zhig lung ston pa'i rmi lam 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de yang rmi lam bzang ba'i ltas ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang mchod rten mthong ba/ dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam lag tu thogs pa/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde'i dbus su zhugs pa/ rang gi bla ma dang mjal ba/ de las chos mnyan pa/

nyi zla shar ba/ rgyal por dbang bskur ba/ rta dang glang po zhon pa la sogs pa byung na bzang ba yin pas zhen pa med pa'i dga' ba bsgom zhing dga' ston bya/ gal te ngan pa'ang 'byung srid de/ de'i ltas ni/ rgya skyegs kyi ri la 'dzegs pa/ ka ra wī ra'i me tog rgyas pa 'thu ba/ mchod sdong dang bye ma dang thal phung la 'dzegs pa/ spre'u dang bong bu la zhon nas kha phyir phyogs te 'gro ba/ chus khyer ba/ skra bregs pa/ lus til mar gyis byugs pa la sogs pa byung na cung zad ngan pa yin pas gnyid sad ma thag tu chos thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad par med de/ don la grub pa gang yang med snyam du bden med kyi sbyang ba'i rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blugs pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas rmi lam ngan pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya dgos pa yin no// de rnams kyis slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams song nas/ 'di'i dngos gzhi sang nyin 'byung ba yin no// zhes brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang ngo*// gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs te/ bum bskyed kyi skabs ltar mchod bstod 'dod don zhus la/ lhag chad kha bskang ba dang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyi mthar/ mtheb srin gyi se gol dang oṃ badzra muḥ sta gon gyi lha rnams sang nang par 'byon par bzhed bzhin pas rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs zhes brjod cing bsams la/ sta gon gyi yo byad dman pa rnams bsdus te/ de'i nub mo dge ba'i gnyid kyis log go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la gsum ste/ dkyil 'khor dang rgyan 'gram pa/ sgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba'o// dang por ras ris phyogs la ni// sta gon byas pa'i gzhi dbus der// bris thang rab gnas ldan pa'i zhal// shar du phyogs par bkram pa'i mthar/

spyi mchod sgos mchod gru bzhir bsham// rdul tshon phyogs la las thig gi /cha dbye sngon du grub nas ni// thog mar thig tshon byin brlab ni// tshon stegs dbus su tshon dkar la// rdo rje'i rtse yis oṃ yig bri// shar du sngon po la ni dzaṃ// lho ser staṃ dang nub dmar moṃ// byang du ljang gu laṃ yig bris// de steng so so'i kha dog dang*// mthun pa'i thig skud rnams kyang gzhag /mdun du mchod pa rnam lnga bsham// de nas slob dpon yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas thig tshon rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i gdan lnga'i steng du/ thig tshon dkar po oṃ las bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can ma sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sogs gong ltar dang*/ sngon po dzaṃ las gtum pa chen mo sngon mo/ ser po staṃ las 'bar ba chen mo/ dmar po moṃ las gos dkar mo/ ljang gu laṃ las sgrol ma sogs nas sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar sku mdog zhal phyag rnams gsal gdab/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ sogs nas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan pa'i bar gyis bskyed la/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar zhes sogs shlau ka gcig gis bstod/ tshon la oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad dang thig la las sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi thig tshon du gyur ces brjod cing*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis yi ge rnams bsubs/ thig skud rnams slob dpon gyi lag par blangs la/ las kyi rdo rje la thig skud dkar sngo sogs rim par gtad de brkyangs la/ phan tshun

sngags su yod kyang bod skad du bris so// rjes su rtogs pa ste// chos kun phan tshun rjes su rtogs// chos rnams thams cad shin tu yangs// kun tu 'gro ba chos kun brjod// ces brjod cing dang por so so dang*/ de nas lhan cig tu bsgril bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gnyis su med par gyur par bsams la rdo rje la dkris te dri bzang gi chus gtor te gzhag go /de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas langs la dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang*/ slob ma gzhan gyis mi thub mar bsams shing*/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor snye mdo bas nub nas shar du phyogs par bshad cing*/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub pas bya spyod thig tshon gyi cho gar dkyus ltar bya bar gsungs so// gyi shar nas nub tu phyogs pas dzaḥgasum brjod cing thig skud gtad/ des kyang dzaḥgasum brjod cing blang*/ gnyis kas thig skud lte ba'i thad kar bzung ste/ slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs// 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na// khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar// thig skud sgras ni bskul ma 'debs// zhes brjod cing thig gi sgra las kyang de lta bu'i sgra byung bar bsams la/ oṃ sū traṃ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing thog mar steng nas 'og tu gcus te nam mkha' la gyen du gdab/ de nas lus dmad de sa gzhi la gdab bo// 'debs pa'i go rim ni/ shar yang na/ nub nub shar zhes pa ltar bya/ lho byang me dbang ldan// me srin rlung srin rlung dbang ldan// me rlung srin dbang nyis 'debs kyi// snga ma slob dpon 'dug sa yin// 'gro tshe rgyab nas g.yas skor du// phyin pas thig rjes g.yas skor 'byung*// zhes pa ltar btab pas dkyil 'khor du lam gyis byung bar bsam mo// de nas slob dpon shar dang 'dir yang dang po'i gnas lugs gang yin dang bstun/

slob ma nub tu gnas pas thig skud bsdu'o// thig btab zin pa na/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu phyin te gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog ste/ oṃ badzra be gā kra ma hoḥzhes pas ye thig nam mkhar bteg pa'i 'og nas 'dzul bar bsam zhing dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs te/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste// sems can khams ni sgrol bar byed// gtsug tor gdugs dkar lha mo yi// dkyil 'khor snying po bri bar bya// oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis dang por dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa phyi nas sngo ser dmar ljang dkar po'i rim par bris la rin po che'i snod kyis bkab ste steng du rdo rje bzhag la/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ de nas dbus nas ci bder bri/ 'dri ba'i tshon gyi kha dog ni// shar sngo la sogs phyogs mdog bya// dbus su padma 'dab brgyad la// lha rnams rang rang phyag mtshan nam// tshon spungs gdan dang bcas pa dgod// 'dod snam la sogs spyi ltar dang*// 'jig rten pa yi khor yug dkar// 'dab ma rdo rwa me ris bcas// dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bris zin nas// tshon gyi lha dang thig mchod de// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang badzra muḥ /zhes pa'i tshig gis gshegs su gsol// dkyil 'khor mtha' skor dris byug cing*// spyi sgos mchod pa zlum por dgod// rgyan dgram lha rnams so so'i sngags// brjod cing rnam rgyal shar mdun dang*// las bum dbang ldan mtshams su 'bul// mda' brgyad mtshon gyi drwa ba dang*// gri dang me long rma bya dang*// phur bu ba dan la sogs pa// phyag len ji bzhin rgyan dgod bya// dkyil 'khor lha la dkar gtor gcig /sgos kyi chos skyong gtor ma dang*// nub tu dmar gtor byang phyogs su// shing thog bcas pa'i gtor zlum bzhi// lho ru cha gsum dkar gtor shar// gdon chen nyi shu rtsa brgyad la// dkar gtor dmar gtor re re bsham// zas su mi za dgu za ba'i// nyi shu rtsa brgyad rdzas dang bcas// gzhi bdag gtor ma'i bar du ni// bzhi bcu rtsa gsum tshang bar bsham// gtor ma rgyas pa'i rim pa'o// bsdus pa bcu ste dbang ldan nas// me yi bar du cha gsum gyi// gtor ma ma gtogs drug rim bsham// 'bring la gtor ma so gsum pa'i// gtor chog bzhin du shes par bya// dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyogs bzhi ru// gdugs dang gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang*// rdo rje rnam 'joms stobs chen te// glegs bam bzhi yang bklag par bya// slob mar dgos pa'i sbyang chas dang*// tshon sku sna lnga mi grangs dang*// sla nga'i nang du zhi ba'i thab// bud shing skam po brtsigs pa dang*// bris pa'i ling ga phur bur bcas// mig dar me tog 'thor nas sogs// dgos pa'i yo byad 'du bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga la/

rang nyid khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas grub na theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong blang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms la/ dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal la gnas pa'i bar sta gon bzhin byas la/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor las bum gyi chus bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ 'khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ steng rdo rje'i gdung dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad bskal pa 'jig pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su suṃ yongs su gyur pa las lhun po rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i steng du sna tshogs padma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bhrūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bskor ba la/ steng nas chu srin gyi kha nas drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ bya 'dabs las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu dkar po/ mda' yab padma'i 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis mdzes pa ste/ de dag gi bar bar du bum pa la gnas pa'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu la gnas pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod pa byed pa/ nang rdo rje'i gdung dang ka ba brgyad kyis mig mang ris su mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi steng 'og gi phyogs thams cad shar sngo lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus dkar ba/

phyi rol du 'jig rten pa'i khor yug dkar pos bskor ba'i dbus su/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar seng ges bteg pa'i khri padma dang zla ba'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad la nyi ma dang*/ phyi'i grwa bzhir padma dang zla ba/ sgo bzhir padma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du yi ge oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus oṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo dkar po lte ba la oṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ khyad par 'jig par byed pa'i gdon dang mdangs 'phrog par byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa chen mo sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo sogs nas dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar gong ltar thugs kar gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang bcas pa bskyed/ padma'i 'dab ma brgyad kyi gdan la/ shar du dzaṃ las gtum pa chen mo sku mdog dkar mo g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub/ gzhan gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ lhor staṃ las 'bar ba chen mo ser mo g.yas rin po che g.yon sdigs mdzub/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ nub tu moṃ las gos dkar mo dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can g.yas padma g.yon sdig mdzub/ gsod pa dang bcings pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ byang du laṃ las sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rmi ltas ngan pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ byang shar du baṃ las rgyal ba'i rdo rje ma sngon mo g.yas dbyug pa g.yon sdigs mdzub/

dug thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ shar lhor paṃ las padma'i dngos mtshan can ser mo g.yas lcags kyu g.yon sdigs mdzub/ mtshon gyi gnod pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ lho nub tu saṃ las gzhan gyis mi thub ma dmar mo g.yas rdo rje'i phreng ba g.yon sdigs mdzub/ me dang chu'i gnod pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ nub byang du saṃ las rdo rje'i mchu can ma ljang gu g.yas ral gri g.yon sdigs mdzub/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma yid tsam khros shing*/ padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// de'i phyi rol byang shar gyi grwar dhaṃ las zhi ba'i lha mo dkar mo g.yas bdug spos kyi snod g.yon sdigs mdzub/ sdang ba'i dgra thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ shar lhor paṃ las zhi ba gser phreng can ser mo g.yas gser phreng g.yon sdigs mdzub/ ma rungs pa'i dgra'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ lho nub tu āṃ las dkar chen 'bar ma dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can g.yas mar me'i sdong bu g.yon sdigs mdzub/ sdang ba gshin rje thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ nub byang du gaṃ las 'phags ma sgrol ma mar gad kyi mdog can g.yas dri'i dung phor g.yon sdigs mdzub/ 'chi ltas rmi ngan thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ thams cad kyang padma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa zhi ba'i ngang tshul can no// shar sgor saṃ las rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma sngon mo g.yas lcags kyu g.yon sdigs mdzub/ pha rol gyi rig sngags ngan pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ lho sgor tsaṃ las rdo rje gzhon nu ma gser ltar ser ba/ g.yas zhags pa g.yon sdigs mdzub/ gdon thams cad 'joms par mdzad ma/ nub sgor aṃ las lag na rdo rje ma dmar mo g.yas lcags sgrog g.yon sdigs mdzub/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dga' ba mdzad ma/

byang sgor aṃ las rin chen rdo rje ma ljang gu g.yas dril bu g.yon sdigs mdzub/ gza' chen po brgyad 'joms par mdzad ma/ bzhi ka'ang padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing cung zad khro ba'i ngang tshul can/ lha mo thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs gsol ba'o// phyi'i khor yug la legs ldan mched gsum/ 'jig rten skyong ba bcu dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu rnams rang rang gi rgyan cha lugs dang lag cha rnams 'chang zhing rang rigs kyi 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas par gyur par bsams la/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i stod du hūm̐ sngon po/ dbus su rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can ma lha bcu bdun rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshegs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas dngos gzhi dang po'i tshe sta gon gyi lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs pa'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa dang*/ gnyis pa man chad rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan 'dren pa yin pas spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin cing*/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// zhes pa nas yang dag 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// zhes sogs dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa sngags dang bcas pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse sogs dang*/

mtshan sngags gong ma'i mthar/ asma tsand+rā sa na tiṣṭhantu swā hā/ zhes pas gdan phul nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas mdun bskyed dang gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha sngar bzhin spyan drangs la mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso 'khor thams cad la mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa re res dbur brgyan zhes sam/ kha cig gtso 'khor rnams la rigs lnga so sos dbur brgyan par 'dod/ kha cig ni lha thams cad la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par 'dod de bya rgyud pa'i bshad pa dang mthun pa'i phyir phyi ma nyid legs so// mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba la so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar dmigs te/ sngags phreng las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas/ bdag dang slob mas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad sbyangs nas/ 'od zer rnams slar 'dus te lha rnams kyi thugs kar thim par bsams la/ lha so so la dmigs te gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags rnams ji ltar rigs par bzlas mthar thal mo sbyar te/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ yo byad rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/

me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa thams cad rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa mchod rdzas ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par byed pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ khyad par bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar po can ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod/ mi nus na thog ma'i mchod pa byin rlabs ltar brjod la/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs mchod pa so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas gdangs dang bcas te/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can nyon mongs bag chags sbyang phyir du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// khams gsum gnas pa'i bag chags dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ dkyil 'khor kun du rgyal ba mnyes byed cing*// kha dog dbyibs legs mdzes pa'i me tog 'di// nam mkha' gang ba sems kyis rab sprul te// gzhal med khang du sprin bzhin gtibs gyur cig /puṣpe me tog dang*/ tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te// sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldan pa// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /dhūppes bdug spos dang*/ nyon mongs dug sreg ma rig mun sel ba'i// shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me 'di// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du// 'od zer snang bas phyogs bcur khyab gyur cig /ā lo kes mar me dang*/ stong gsum kun du dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang sbyar ba'i chu// ye shes mkha' la bdud rtsi'i char babs pas// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig

/gandhes dri chab dang*/ rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don phyir lha yi bdud rtsi'i bshos// dag cing gtsang mar sbyar 'di 'bul lags na// ye shes thugs rje can gyis bzhes su gsol// nai wi dyais zhal zas dang*/ dril chen gsung dbyangs rnam rol tshangs pa'i dbyangs// bsam gtan ngag gis bstod cing gsol 'debs na// sa bcu rim gyis bgrod la thogs med cing*// tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas chos kyi rgyal por smon// shapda rol mo'i sgra dharmā ra ṇi dang bcas pas mchod/ gzhan yang*/ oṃ sarba bitpū ra sogs kyis dpag tu med par spel nas/ rgyal srid bdun dang 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa rnams spyi ltar byas la/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ bde gshegs thugs rje'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing*// bde 'byung bstan la gnod pa phyir bzlog cing*// bde gshegs 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i// bde mchog gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal lo// skyabs sbyin la sogs phyag rgya sna tshogs kyis// rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen padma dang*// ral gri mda' gzhu zhags pa sogs bsnams pa'i// phyag stong mnga' ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dkar sngo dmar ser ljang gu'i kha dog can// sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang*// zhi dang khro dang 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan pa'i// dbu stong mnga' ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dbu dang phyag sogs sku yi cha rnams la// zur gyis blta dang rnam par bgrad pa dang*// glog ltar 'khyug byed bye ba brgya stong gi /spyan rnams mnga' ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje lta bur mi phyed brtan pa'i sku// dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i me dpung gis// bgegs rnams 'joms shing dngos grub myur stsol ba'i// mi phyed 'bar ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'bar ba'i mthus// thogs pa med cing shin tu yangs pa yi// sa gsum dkyil 'khor kun la mnga' mdzad ma// srid gsum dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ma rungs 'byung po mtha' dag gdul ba'i phyir// mi bzad 'jigs tshul gtso mo drag shul can// 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'i dbus na bzhugs// gdug pa tshar gcod ma la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs kar pad nyir gzhan gyis mi thub ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis char sprin ltar gnag cing*// phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// 'byung gdon tshar gcod khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// shar gyi padma'i 'dab mar gtum chen mo// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gangs ri'i mdog ltar dkar// phyag g.yas 'khor lo g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// gzhan gyi sbyor ngan 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// lho yi padma'i 'dab mar 'bar chen mo// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser gyi mdog ltar ser// phyag g.yas rin chen g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// dus min 'chi ba 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// nub kyi padma'i 'dab mar gos dkar mo// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar dmar can// phyag g.yas padma g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// gsod dang bcings pa dgrol la phyag 'tshal lo// byang gi padma'i 'dab mar sgrol ma che// zhal gcig phyag gnyis margad lta bur ljang*// g.yas pa sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub// rmi ltas ngan pa 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// byang shar 'dab mar rgyal ba'i rdo rje ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis nam mkha'i mdog ltar sngo// phyag g.yas dbyug pa g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// dug rnams 'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// shar lho'i 'dab mar padma'i mngon mtshan can// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser bzang mdog mtshungs ma// phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// mtshon gyi gnod pa 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// lho nub 'dab mar gzhan gyis mi thub ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis li khri'i mdog ltar dmar// phyag g.yas rdo rje'i phreng ba g.yon sdigs mdzub// me chu'i gnod pa 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// nub byang 'dab mar rdo rje mchu can ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis margad mdog ltar ljang*// g.yas pa ral gri g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// gnod sbyin srin po 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// byang shar grwa ru zhi ba'i lha mo ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis ston ka'i zla ltar dkar// phyag g.yas bdug spos g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// dgra rnams 'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// shar lho'i grwa ru zhi ba gser phreng can// zhal gcig phyag gnyis btso ma gser gyi mdog

/g.yas pa gser phreng g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// ma rungs dgra chen 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// lho nub grwa ru dkar chen 'bar ba mo// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar dmar can// phyag g.yas mar me g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// sdang ba gshin rje 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo// nub byang grwa ru 'phags ma sgrol ma ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog margad mdog /phyag g.yas dri yi dung chos g.yon sdigs mdzub// 'chi ltas rmi ngan 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// shar gyi sgo ru rdo rje lu gu rgyud// zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbang sngon mdog ltar sngo// phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// pha rol rig sngags 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// lho yi sgo ru rdo rje gzhon nu ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser bzang mdog mtshungs ma// g.yas pas zhags pa g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// gdon rnams 'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// nub kyi sgo ru lag na rdo rje ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis byi ru'i mdog ltar dmar// phyag g.yas lcags sgrog g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// rgyu skar dga' bar byed la phyag 'tshal lo// byang gi sgo ru rdo rje rin chen ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis margad mdog dang mtshungs// g.yas pas dril bu g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// gza' rnams 'joms par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi rol khor yug dkar po la gnas pa'i// dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum 'khor dang bcas// phyogs skyong bcu dang rgyal po chen po bzhi// gza' skar lha klu 'jigs byed dgu la sogs// mthu stobs che dang gzi brjid mtha' yas pa// bstan pa srung mdzad rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod do// de nas bla ma chos rgyal 'phags pa rin po ches/ bdag srung gtso mo'i yon tan dran// 'jigs pa bzlog dang gdon rnams 'joms// rig sngags gcad dang dam can bskul// thams cad bzlog dang rims nad bsrung*// mtshams bcad bcing ba'i phan yon dang*// srid 'phel la sogs kha tshar las// zhes mdo'i dbu zhabs bsdus pa'i sdom tshig dang*/

mdo las sangs rgyas rnal 'byor du bya'o zhes pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ mdo bdun nam ji ltar 'os pa bklag ste/ bzlog pa la sogs pa'i skabs yin na mdo bklag par bya zhing*/ slob ma dbang bskur ba la ma byas kyang chad pa'i nyes pa med do// de nas phrin las gzhol ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog pa chen mo/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba chen mo/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen mo sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad mas/ bdag dang slob mas sam sbyin bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong ba dang*/ mi nad dang*/ phyugs nad dang*/ yams kyi nad dang*/ 'tshe ba dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ nad 'go ba dang*/ 'khrug pa dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ yang na thams cad las bskyab tu gsol lam bsrung du gsol zhes gang 'os bsgyur ba 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre'o// oṃ dzambha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ shar gyi gtum chen mas bdag dang slob mas sam sbyin bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyang ba dang gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ stambha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ lho phyogs kyi 'bar ba chen mos bdag dang slob mas sam sbyin bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyang ba dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ de bzhin du bdag dang slob mas sam sbyin bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyang ba dang zhes pa kun la sbyar te/

oṃ mo hā na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ nub phyogs kyi gos dkar mos/ gsad pa dang bcing ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ laṃ bha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ byang phyogs kyi sgrol mas/ rmi ltas ngan pa'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ ba ha ni ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ byang shar gyi rgyal ba'i rdo rje mas/ brtan g.yo'i dug gi gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ pa ra bi ṣa saṃ bhakṣa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ shar lho'i padma'i mngon mtshan can mas/ mtshon gyi gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ sarba duṣṭāṃ pra duṣṭān stambha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ lho nub kyi gzhan gyis mi thub mas/ me dang chu'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ sarba yakṣa rākṣa sa gra hā ṇāṃ bi dhānsa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ nub byang gi rdo rje mchu can mas/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ badzra dhūppe āḥhūm̐ druṃ/ byang shar gyi zhi ba chen mos/ dgra'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ druṃ/ shar lho'i zhi ba gser gyi phreng can mas/ ma rungs dgra chen gyi gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ druṃ/ lho nub kyi dkar chen mos/ gshin rje'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ druṃ/ nub byang gi 'phags ma sgrol mas rmi ltas ngan pa'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ sarba pā rā bi dyā tstshe da na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ shar sgo'i rdo rje lu gu rgyud mas/ gzhan gyi rig sngags kyi gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ tsa tu rā shi tī nāṃ gra ha sa ha sra ṇāṃ bi dhwānsa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ lho sgo'i rdo rje gzhon nu mas/ gdon stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/

oṃ aṣṭa biṃ sha tī nāṃ nakṣa tra ṇāṃ pra sā dha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ nub sgo'i lag na rdo rje mas/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ oṃ aṣṭā nāṃ ma hā gra hā ṇāṃ bi dhwānsa na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ byang sgo'i rdo rje rin chen mas/ gza' chen mo brgyad kyi gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das gdung bdun/ de bzhin gshegs pa bcu/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ phyi'i khor yug la gnas pa legs ldan mched gsum/ 'jig rten skyong ba bcu/ rgyal po chen po bzhi/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag dang slob mas sam sbyin bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi mi nad dang phyugs nad sogs gong ltar brjod pas phrin las gsol lo// dngos gzhi gnyis pa man dgos pa'i tshe bum pa sta gon gyi skabs bzhin 'dir bsgrub bo// de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ bshams pa'i gtor ma thams cad chu gtsang gis sbreng ste/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum dang*/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma dang po dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs lan gsum gyis phul la mchod bstod phrin las zhu/ gnyis pa sgos kyi chos skyong spyan drangs la 'bul/

gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa rnams legs ldan mched gsum la dbul te/ mdun du paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ gsum las/ legs ldan nag po dka' thub bzlog pa g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ legs ldan sred med kyi bu phyag rgya chen po lngas phyag byas pa g.yas rtse gsum g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ legs ldan nag po chen po grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jigs par byed pa phyag gnyis tsandan gyi bing 'dzin cing sprul pa'i dmag tshogs 'gyed pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa'i do shal byas pa/ rang gi 'khor gyis bskor ba dang bcas par bsam/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa bstim la oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ ma hā kā la mā tri ga ṇa na maḥkṛ tā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā btags pa lan gsum gyis gtso bo gsum dang*/ brahma ṇi ye/ biṣṇa bī ye/ ma he shwa rī ye/ rau dri ye/ ma hā kā lī ye/ tsa muṇḍī ye/ kau mā rī ye/ bā rā hī ye/ ind+rī ye/ agnī ye/ ya mā yai/ nai ṛ tyā yai/ ba ru ṇā yai/ ma ru tī yai/ sau mā yai/ ī sha nī ye/ kā la daṇḍī ye/ kā la rā trī ye/ ya ma daṇḍī ye/ rā trī ye/ kā pā lī ye/ a dhi mukti shma shā na ba si nī ye/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis 'khor rnams la 'bul/ hūm̐ bstan pa srung dang bgegs tshogs 'joms// legs nyes bstang 'dzin dam tshig can// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa'i// legs ldan 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal// bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can ma'i bkas/ legs ldan nag po mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pas/ bdag dang slob ma'am sbyin bdag dang sems can thams cad yongs su bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/

chad pa bzlog par mdzod cig ces pa'i gsol gdab 'di 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar ro// drug pa bdun pa brgyad pa dgu pa rnams rgyal chen bzhi la dbul te/ oṃ tsa tur ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs la mchod/ oṃ dhṛ ta rāṣṭā ya/ bi rū ḍha kā ya/ bi rū pākṣā ya/ ku bai rā ya/ sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā btags la dbul/ ri rab chen po'i phyogs bzhi nas// rgyal po chen po sde bzhi yang*// btsun mo sras 'khor bcas pa la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes dang phrin las zhu/ bcu pa dang bcu gcig pa cha gsum bzhin phyogs skyong 'byung po la gtong ngo*// bcu gnyis pa dang bcu gsum pa gdon nyer brgyad la dbul te/ mi sdug 'tshe ba'i ngang tshul can// gdon chen nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa// rang rang 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ e hye his spyan drangs la mchod/ sarba de we bhyaḥ sarba nā ge bhyaḥ sarba rākṣa se bhyaḥ sarba bhū ti bhyaḥ sarba pre ta bhyaḥ sarba pi shā tse bhyaḥ sarba kumbhaṇḍe bhyaḥ sarba pū ta ne bhyaḥ sarba ka ṭa pū ta ne bhyaḥ sarba skande bhyaḥ sarba unmā de bhyaḥ sarba tstshā ye bhyaḥ sarba a pasmā re bhyaḥ sarba osta rā ge bhyaḥ sarba ḍākki nī bhyaḥ sarba rāe ba tī bhyaḥ sarba ya ma yai bhyaḥ sarba sha ku ne bhyaḥ sarba mā tri ga ṇe bhyaḥ sarba kambu ka ni bhyaḥ sarba a wa lamba ke bhyaḥ sarba kaṇḍi ni bhyaḥ sarba gandharbhe bhyaḥ sarba a su re bhyaḥ sarba kinne re bhyaḥ sarba ga ru ḍe bhyaḥ sarba ma ho ra ge bhyaḥ sarba yakṣe bhyaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā btags pas phul la phrin las zhu/ bcu bzhi nas bzhi bcu zhe gcig gi bar gzi brjid 'phrog pa'i gdon rnams la 'bul te/ gzi brjid 'phrog dang mdangs 'phrog dang*// mngal za sha za la sogs pa// nyi shu rtsa brgyad gdon gyi tshogs// 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ e hye his spyan drangs la mchod/
