te dzau dzā hā ra/ ba liṃ/ garbha/ ru bhi ra/ ba sā/ māṃ sā/ me da/ mar dza/ dzā ta/ dzī wi ta/ bi rī kṣa/ mā li/ gandha/ dhū pa/ puṣpa/ pha la/ ba sye/ a hu ti/ pū ya/ gu tha/ bi ṭa/ khe ṭa/ bānti/ slasme/ siṃ ghā ni ga a putstsha/ dunta ni ka a hā re bhyaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā sogs btags pas bsngos la/ gdon chen nyer brgyad 'khor bcas ni// gzi brjid 'phrog dang mdangs za bar// gzugs brnyan khrag snas brgyan pa re// gtor ma za la phyi nang tshil// rab tu sbyar ba'i gtor ma 'bul// mngal za ba la mngar gsum rtsi// khrag 'thung ba la khrag sna 'bul// zhag za ba la zhag dang bcud// sha za ba la sha yi tshogs// tshil za ba la phyi nang tshil// rkang za ba la rkang mar 'bul// btsas pa za bar bu ram dang*// shing kun sbyar ba 'di dag 'bul// srog 'phrog pa la 'o ma dang*// zho dang ka ra bcas pa 'bul// lhag ma za la rdzas kun gyi// lhag ma bsdus nas dbul bar bya// phreng ba ma la ru rakṣa// bo de tsi la sogs pa 'bul// dri za ba la ga pur dang*// bzang drug sman dang bcas pa 'bul// bdug pa za la sbyar spos dang*// dri dang 'bru mar sbyar ba 'bul// me tog za la me tog rigs// 'bras bu za la bu ram dang*// shing thog sna tshogs bcas pa 'bul// lo thog za la 'bras bzang dang*// 'bras dang nas kyi snye ma 'bul// sbyin sreg za la 'bru bcud dang*// 'bras kyi lag ban dbul bar bya// rnag za ba la rul pa'i sha /phyi sa za la khur ba 'bul// gcin 'thung ba la rgun 'brum chang*// 'bras chang bcud dang bcas pa 'bul// mchil ma 'thung la sbrang dang bcud// skyug pa za la sbrang rtsi'i bcud// bya mo'i sgong nga snabs za la// bya sgong ngar snabs za la 'bul// mi gtsang za la sgog chang dang*// la phug rkyen dang sbyar la 'bul// stor khung nas 'bab 'thung ba la// chu sna mang por bcud sbyar 'bul// rang rang mthun rdzas 'di bzhes la// gnod pa'i bsam sbyor zhi ba dang*// phan pa'i sems dang ldan pa yis// bde legs thams cad 'grub par mdzod// ces dang phrin las gong bzhin bcol la/

zhe gnyis pa gzhi bdag la 'bul/ zhe gsum pa cha gsum cho gas sbyin no// gtor ma bcu las med na/ dang po gtso mo la/ gnyis pa sgos kyi chos skyong la/ gsum pa legs ldan mched gsum la/ bzhi pa rgyal chen bzhi la/ lnga pa drug pa phyogs skyong 'byung po la/ bdun pa brgyad pa dkar gtor dmar gtor gnyis gdon nyer brgyad la/ dgu pa gzhi bdag la/ bcu pa bgegs la btang ste 'di ltar byas kyang lag len bde'o// de nas 'dir sgrub pa'i grogs shig gis las sngags bzla zhing dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug nas phyi rol du gtor ma gtang bar bshad pa dang*/ gzhan 'gar cha gsum gtor ma phyi rol du gtang ba'i lugs kyang yod mod/ 'dir nang du btang grub cing*/ 'dir yang phyi rol gtor ma btang bar spro na/ gtor ma dkar dmar gnyis gong sngon 'gro'i skabs ltar gtang ba dang*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma dang bgegs gtor gnyis kyang nang du mi gtong bar phyi rol tu gtang ngo*// nye reg rgyas pa ni rdo rje phreng ba ltar bya/ bsdu na kha bshal ba tsam byas nas nang du 'ongs nas yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing*/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang*/ phyag gsum byas te gdan la 'khod do// gsum pa 'jug cing dbang blang ba la/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni cho ga spogs pa rnams bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo gnyis su med pas mdzad par bsams shing*/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i slob ma gzhug pa ltar byab srung bum dbang dang bcas pa'i bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho gar byas te nyams su blang bar bya'o// gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba la/ sngon du 'gro ba'i bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi'i bya ba gnyis las/ dang po la'ang byad dgrol ba dang*/ bkru byab bsrung gsum bya ba'i dang po byad dgrol ba'i slad du/ bsgrub bya rnams bos nas gral la 'khod pa la sngar gyi tshon skud la/

slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu thogs bzhin pas lag len ltar mdud khug byas pa bsgrub bya tsog por 'khod pa'i mgul pa dang*/ lag pa'i srin mdzub gnyis dang rkang pa'i mthe bo gnyis rnams su bcing*/ sbyong chas mdun du bshams pa chus sbreng ste zhi ba dang*/ zhi drag phyed ma dang drag po'i sbyong ba rnams spyi ltar byas la 'di skad brjod do// khyed rnams mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs pa pha rol gyis byas pa'i byad gtad la sogs pas bcings pa dgrol ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can mar gsal ba la mos gus byas pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer rno zhing thogs pa med pa lcags kyu'i rnam pa can grangs med pa 'phros/ khyed rnams kyi lus kyi phyi nang dang snod bcud kyi 'jig rten thams cad du khyab pas/ khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la bar du gcod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib/ byad byur la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs su gyur pa thams cad 'od zer sngo dmar dang*/ dud khu sol khu'am/ rnag khrag gi rnam pa can dang*/ gdon bgegs la sogs pa sdig sbal dang srog chags mi sdug pa'i rnam pa can du tshur bkug ste/ lus la bcings pa'i tshon skud 'di la sib kyis thim par mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcings te/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ rdo rje slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la bar du gcod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib/ rmi lam ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur ba thams cad dang*/ byad dang mnan gtad du bcug pa la sogs pa gzhan gyis rig sngags kyi sbyor ba ngan pa brtsams pa'i nus mthu thams cad rang dbang med par bkug ste/ lus la bcings pa'i tshon skud lnga po 'di la gnyis su med par thim par gyur cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i dgug gzhug lan gsum/ de nas khyed rnams kyi lus bcings pa'i tshon skud 'di rnams nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'dus pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur par mos pa mdzod ces brjod de/ ral gri me'i dbal dang chur bcug pa thogs nas/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das mar gsal bas ye shes kyi ral gri me dang chus ngar dang ldan par byas pa de nyid kyis tshon skud rnams dum bur bcad pas bar du gcod pa thams cad dang bral bar byas par mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la lha sngags rnams zlos shing phyag gi ral gris slob ma la gnod par byed pa thams cad tshar gcod par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon thams cad dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// kun tu rgyus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// tshangs pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// dbang phyug chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// sred med kyi bus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// nam mkha' lding dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// nag po chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// ma mo'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// mi'i thod pa can gyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// rgyal bar byed pa dang sbrang rtsir byed pa dang*/

don kun grub pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// srin mo bzhis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// bhṛng gi ri te dang dga' byed dbang phyug dang tshogs kyi bdag po dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// dge sbyong gcer bus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// dge sbyong mgo reg gis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// dgra bcom pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// 'dod chags dang bral bas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// lag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// pho nya dang pho nya mo dang bran pho dang bran mos byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// drang srong gi tshogs thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// mi 'phrod pa za ba'i bdag pos byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// zhes brjod cing phyag g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas tshon skud rgyab phyogs nas bzung*/ g.yas pas ral gri'i so phyir bstan te mgrin pa dang de bzhin du lag pa dang rkang pa'i tshon skud rnams bcad la dum bu rnams rdo'am bong ba la dkris te/ slob ma la bskor zhing dor ba dang*/ yungs kar dang me dang chu dang*/ 'brus kyang bskor zhing snod der dor la thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags ring bzla zhing byur bsal lo// kha cig shog bu la liṅga byas pa la dgug gzhug byas te/ brub khung nang du bcug la phur bus 'debs pa'i phyag len yod pas de ltar byed par spro na/ bris pa'i liṅga mdun du bzhag la/ rje btsun rtsa ba sogs nas bkug ste mtshan ma rdzas kyi liṅga 'di la khug cig ces dang dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mang du brjod/ phur bu skad cig gis gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'i skur gyur par bsams la/ lha so so'i sngags dang thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags ring brjod cing*/

phur bu lag pas bsgril zhing rdo rje slob ma rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon thams cad dang mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// phyag rgyas mnan no// tho bas brdung ngo*// zhes pa nas/ mi 'phrod pa za ba'i bdag pos byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// tho bas brdung ngo*// zhes pa'i bar 'don pa spos la gong ltar brjod/ liṅga rnams drag po'i sbyin sreg gis bsregs pa'i thal ba yin na mnan pa byar btub la/ liṅga bri ba sogs ma grub na sngar gyi zhi ba'i thab kyi nye logs su bzhag pa la me sbar/ las bum gyi chu dang sngags gnyis kyis bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgya tshad yongs su ma chad pa nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang ba las me 'bar ba/ de'i dbus su gtso mo zhal phyag rdzogs pa'am phyag gnyis ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa'i sku las ye shes kyi me 'bar bas slob ma rnams kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs par bsams la/ spos dang me tog dang 'bru sna tshogs mar dang bcas pa'i tshon skud bsgrub bya la bskor zhing*/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas ye shes kyi me lha la dbul bar bsams la/ oṃ a si tā na lārka pra bhā sphu ṭa bi ka si tā ha pa tre/ dzwa la dzwa la/ kha da kha da/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ dha ra dha ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ tshindha tshindha/ bindha bindha/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ he he phaṭa/ ho ho phaṭa/ a mo gha ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ya phaṭa/ wa ra dā ya phaṭa/ wa ra pra da na ya phaṭa/ pra tyaṃ gi ra phaṭa/ ces lan nyi shu rtsa gcig phul/ mthar rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dang nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod la/ mchod bstod byas la thab kyi lha oṃ badzra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams pa ni byad dgrol ba'o// gnyis pa bkru byab bsrung gsum bya ba ni/

dang po ni las bum gyi chus dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams me long la shar ba'i gzugs brnyan la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus gsol/ sku phyi ba dang bcas pa byas te/ khrus chu de bum par blugs la lha rnams kyi sku las babs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chus khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad gdon sdig sgrib byad gtad la sogs pa'i nye bar 'tshe bar byed pa thams cad bkrus par mos shing*/ lha thams cad kyi sngags rnams brjod pa'i mthar/ che ge mos 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes kun la sbyar te/ rims nyin gcig pa rnams dang*/ nyin gnyis pa rnams dang*/ nyin gsum pa rnams dang*/ nyin bzhi pa rnams dang*/ nyin bdun pa rnams dang*/ rtag pa'i rims rnams dang*/ rims mi bzad pa rnams dang*/ 'byung po'i rims rnams te rims kyi gnod pa thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ nad rlung las gyur pa rnams dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa rnams dang*/ bad kan las gyur pa rnams dang*/ 'dus pa las gyur pa la sogs pa'i nad thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ lha'i gdon rnams dang*/ klu'i gdon rnams dang*/ lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang*/ rlung lha'i gdon la sogs te gdon thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ zas su mdangs 'phrog pa dang*/ zas su mngal za ba la sogs pa'i bgegs thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ rgyal po'i 'jigs pa thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ rkun po'i 'jigs pa thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ me'i 'jigs pa thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ chu'i 'jigs pa thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ dug gi 'jigs pa thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ mtshon gyi 'jigs pa thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi 'jigs pa thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ dgra'i 'jigs pa thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/

dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa'i gnod byed bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa ni bkru ba yin/ de nas byab pa'i slad du bum chu khar 'dzin du bcug la/ rma bya'i mdongs kyi dbus su oṃ yig las sngags phreng gis bskor ba de nyid slob dpon gyi lag pas rdo rje dang lhan cig thogs nas khyed rnams kyi lus la bskor zhing byabs pas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa dang nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad byab par bsam zhing rma bya'i mjug mas byab pa'i tshul dang*/ lha so so'i sngags dang bcas pa'i sngar gyi tshig de rnams la/ a pa na ya swā hā/ zhes sbyar te byabs pas gnod byed thams cad skyug sman btang ba bzhin du skyugs par bsams la mdun gyi chu nang du pho/ de nas chu bsgrub bya la bskor zhing bden bdar gong ltar brjod/ mthar che ge mo rnams la gnod pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad 'dir ma gnas par dengs shig ces rol mo tshom rngam bya'o// gu gul gyi dud pas bdugs la/ gnod byed thams cad chu dang lhan cig tu phyi rol du dor ba ni byab pa yin/ bsrung ba'i slad du/ bden pa'i tshig gis byin gyis brlabs kyis bsrung ba ni/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal// chos ni chos ma yin las rgyal// dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las rgyal// dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal// lha min zla ba las ni rgyal// nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las// me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal// chu ni me las rgyal bar 'gyur// rlung ni sprin las rab tu rgyal// rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden pas rab tu gnas// sa yang bden pas gnas pa lags// sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden// bden pa rgyal 'gyur rdzun ma mchis// dza ya dza ya/ zhes pa'i tshigs bcad brjod cing spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ rol mo bya/ srung 'khor yod na 'dir lha so so'i sngags la rakṣa btags pa bzlas pas spyi bor gdags so// slar yang slob dpon gyis khyed rnams kyi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas bdun du rdo rjes reg pas rdo rje de las de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa chad de lus thams cad du rdo rje'i go bgos te phyin chad bar du gcod pas mi tshugs par byin gyis brlabs par mos zhes dang*/

gong gi bkru ba'i skabs kyi tshig rnams kyi mthar rakṣa rakṣa zhes btags te brjod pa ni bsrung ba ste/ des bkru byab bsrung ba rnams ni sngon du 'gro ba'i bya ba'o// snye mdo ba'i yi ger slob ma sta gon 'dir byas kyang rung zhes 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i bya ba la/ las kyi rdo rjes slob ma rnams la me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod do// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sogs kyis sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ 'dir gsan par bya ba'i chos ni rig sngags 'chang gi sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa bya ba'i rgyud kyi nang gses de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ de la'ang dbye ba brgyad yod pa las 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi gtsug tor/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir bzlog pa chen mo mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi rgyal po sogs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas ma hā paṇḍi ta shu raṃ ga warma sogs kyis legs par bkral ba'i gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can ma lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la/ sta gon gyi cho ga dang*/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga gnyis las/ dang po sngon du grub zin to// gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/ sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad legs par grub par byas pa yin/ phyi ma khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma la bya ba'i cho ga la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga dang*/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gnyis las/ dang po dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal dbul du gzhug de ltar phul nas/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rig sngags lha mo chen mo dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// lha mo bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal// zhes pas gsol ba gdab/

bgegs bsal ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byon nas/ khyed rnams dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta brjod cing las bum gyi chus gtor/ bdug spos kyis kyang bdug ste sbyangs par mos/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod cing gu gul dkar pos bdug go /sngon chad bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am/ zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du ras yug dmar po res gdong bcing bar mos/ oṃ tsakṣu bandha wā ra ṇā ya hūm̐ zhes pas gdong bcing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi btub pas phyag rten gyi don du u dumbā ra la sogs pa'i me tog gi phreng ba re'ang byin par mos/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes pas byin/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang sogs nas yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ces pa'i bar sta gon ltar brda sprad de/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs brjod do// 'dir rigs lnga'i sdom gzung ni/ bya rgyud rang rkang lugs ltar/ bdag nyid lha'i snyems pa med pa sogs dang*/ slob ma'ang sngar rnal 'byor rgyud yan chad kyi dbang bskur ma thob pa zhig la ni bya mi dgos la/ da lta'i cho ga phal cher rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rgyas 'gebs kyi/ bdag bskyed sogs yod pa'am slob ma'ang sdom pa thams cad 'dzin pa sngar khas blangs pa zhig la dgongs nas/ ji ltar dus gsum sogs sdom gzung byas pa'ang 'byung bas gnas skabs shes na gang babs btub bam snyam/ nang gi 'jug par slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'khrid par mos te dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su dbu dud pa re dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas shar sgor 'khod par mos/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar po can ma'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa la lus ngag yid gsum gus pa dang ldan pas phyag byas par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can zhes sogs shlau ka gcig gam/ yang na/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa nas spyan rgyas pa utpa la'i bsung gi tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i bar gyis 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ legs ldan drag po zhes sogs kyis 'jig rten pa rnams la phyag 'tshal/ gsang sngags nang gi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams kyi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba lta bu zhig dang*/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa zhig lam gyis byung bar mos te/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi/ zhes thun mong ma yin pa'i sems bskyed pa de/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag ste/ su ra ti sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥsiddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas brtan par byas/ gsang bar gdams pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa dang lha mo ri khrod ma rnams kyi rigs su gyur gyis/ ngas gdugs dkar mo'i sems bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang gdugs dkar po can dang*/ ri khrod ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du brjod par mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes pas gsang bar gdams nas/

nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba kha bskangs nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang gdugs dkar po can mas byin gyis rlobs la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams skad cig tsam gyis padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa chen mo/ sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba/ phyag stong mnga' ba nas/ 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'i dbus na gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar gyi zhal phyag rdzogs par gsal 'debs rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pas bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad/ bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar po can ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi rnam pa che ba ri rab tsam nas chung ba rdul phran tsam gyi bar grangs med pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyi lus la thim/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor las kyang de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byon te khyed rang rnams la sib kyis thim pas byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod ces dang*/ lha rnams kyi sngags tshang bar bzla zhing rol mo bya'o// de ni ye shes dbab pa ste de'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste brtan par byas par mos/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod pas brtan par byas nas/ dkyil 'khor la me tog dbul ba ni/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das ma'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ de'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes yongs su dag pa nyid gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi dbang gis gtso bo dang 'khor gyi rnam pa can du snang ba yin pa'i phyir mchog dman gyi khyad par med mod/

rang rang gi las 'brel yod pa'i lha zhig la 'bab par shog shig snyam pas rim pa bzhin du langs te dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes brjod cing me tog 'bul ba'i tshul mdzod/ phul ba'i me tog de slob dpon gyis blangs nas khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste oṃ pra ti gṛhṇa st+waṃ mi maṃ satwa ma hā ba la zhes me tog gang la phog pa'i lha dang ngo sprad de/ byin gyis brlabs par mos/ slob dpon gyis badzra ne tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥ zhes pas ma rig pa'i sgrib byed dang mig ras lhan cig tu bsal bar mos zhes gdong g.yogs dbye/ he badzra pa shya zhes pas dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo bstan pa ni/ 'di na de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gyi dkyil 'khor bzhugs te/ de'ang rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re phyi rol thams cad bskal pa 'jig pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su lhun po rin chen sna bzhi las grub pa'i steng du sna tshogs padma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ steng thog rim par phub pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi steng 'og gi phyogs thams cad shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus dkar ba/ phyi rol du 'jig rten pa'i khor yug dkar pos bskor ba'i dbus su/ sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar seng ges bteg pa'i khri padma dang zla ba'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad la nyi ma dang*/ phyi'i grwa bzhir padma dang zla ba/ sgo bzhir padma dang nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas pa ni rten gzhal yas khang pa yin la/ brten pa lha ni dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa chen mo/

sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba sogs mngon rtogs ltar brjod pa'am/ mi nus na/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba chen mo/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'i dbus na gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'i thugs kar gzhan gyis mi thub ma nag mo dang bcas pa/ padma'i 'dab ma brgyad kyi gdan la shar du gtum pa chen mo sku mdog dkar mo/ lhor 'bar ba chen mo ser mo/ nub tu gos dkar mo dkar dmar/ byang du sgrol ma ljang gu/ byang shar du rgyal ba'i rdo rje ma sngon mo/ shar lhor padma'i mngon mtshan can ma ser mo/ lho nub tu gzhan gyis mi thub ma dmar mo/ nub byang du rdo rje mchu can ma ljang gu/ de'i phyi rol byang shar gyi grwar zhi ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ shar lhor gser phreng can ser mo/ lho nub tu dkar chen 'bar ma dkar dmar/ nub byang du 'phags ma sgrol ma margad kyi mdog can/ shar sgor rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma sngon mo/ lho sgor rdo rje gzhon nu ma gser mdog nub sgor lag na rdo rje ma dmar mo/ byang sgor rin chen rdo rje ma ljang gu ste lha mo thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs gsol zhing skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// phyi'i khor yug la legs ldan mched gsum/ 'jig rten skyong ba bcu sogs nas/ rigs kyi 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas pa ni brten pa lha ste mdor na gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar mthong ngo snyam pa'i dga' ba khyad par can bsgom 'tshal/ des dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga rnams grub nas/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la/

bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo tha mi dad pa la/ dbang gi dngos gzhi'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul/ de ltar maṇḍal 'bul ba kha bskangs nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ de nas dbang stegs yod na der slob ma rnams gzhag med na bsams kyang rung ste dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bral ba'i dbus su rin po che'i khri padma zla ba dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams oṃ dkar po las bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma sogs nas gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'i bar bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin byed/ de'i steng du bla re/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor kun du dung la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas te yod par mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can ma'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' lha dang drang srong gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs te nam mkha'i gtos khyab par bzhugs par mos te/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ dus gsum bde gshegs sprul pa'i sku// zhes sogs nas/ phyag rgya'i tshogs ni thams cad kyis// bdag la mngon par dbang bskur gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo dang dbyer med lhan cig pas bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ sngags dang bcas pa'i mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣṇī ṣa sogs nas biddhānsa ni ka rī hūm̐ druṃ hrīṣṭoṃ/ zhes pa'i bar lha thams cad kyi sngags la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ btags te/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ slar yang bskur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pas/ bden pa'i stobs brjod de bde legs su sgrub par byin gyis brlab pa ni/ slob dpon gyis bum pa thogs bzhin pa dang bcas te/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can/ rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa chen mo/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba chen mo/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen mo sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad mas/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams dang sems can thams cad rgyal po'i 'jigs pa dang*/ rkun po'i 'jigs pa dang*/ me'i 'jigs pa dang*/ chu'i 'jigs pa dang*/ dug gi 'jigs pa dang*/ mtshon gyi 'jigs pa dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi 'jigs pa dang*/ mu ge'i 'jigs pa dang*/ dgra'i 'jigs pa dang*/ lce 'bab pa'i 'jigs pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang*/ sa g.yo ba'i 'jigs pa dang*/ skar mda' ltung ba'i 'jigs pa dang*/ rgyal po'i chad pa'i las kyi 'jigs pa dang*/ lha'i 'jigs pa dang*/ klu'i 'jigs pa dang*/ glog gi 'jigs pa dang*/ nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang*/ gcan gzan khro bo'i 'jigs pa ste/ 'jigs pa mi bzad pa thams cad las slob ma 'di rnams dang sems can thams cad srung du gsol/ oṃ hūm̐ ṣṭoṃ bandha bandha rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarba satwāṃ shtsa bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ lha'i gdon rnams dang*/ klu'i gdon rnams dang*/ lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang*/ rlung lha'i gdon rnams dang*/ nam mkha' lding gi gdon rnams dang*/

dri za'i gdon rnams dang*/ mi'am ci'i gdon rnams dang*/ lto 'phye chen po'i gdon rnams dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang*/ srin po'i gdon rnams dang*/ yi dwags kyi gdon rnams dang*/ sha za'i gdon rnams dang*/ 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang*/ grul bum gyi gdon rnams dang*/ srul po'i gdon rnams dang*/ lus srul po'i gdon rnams dang*/ skem byed kyi gdon rnams dang*/ brjed byed kyi gdon rnams dang*/ smyo byed kyi gdon rnams dang*/ grib gnon gyi gdon rnams dang*/ gnon po'i gdon rnams dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon rnams dang*/ nam gru'i gdon rnams dang*/ gshin rje'i gdon rnams dang*/ bya'i gdon rnams dang*/ ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon rnams dang*/ kun du 'gro ba'i gdon rnams dang*/ tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon te gdon thams cad las rdo rje slob ma rnams dang sems can thams cad srung du gsol/ oṃ hūm̐ ṣṭoṃ bandha bandha rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarba sa twāṃ shtsa bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ gnod sbyin dang gdon gang su dag zas su mdangs za ba rnams dang*/ gzi byin 'phrog pa rnams dang*/ zas su mngal za ba rnams dang*/ khrag 'thung ba rnams dang*/ zhag za ba rnams dang*/ sha za ba rnams dang*/ tshil za ba rnams dang*/ rkang za ba rnams dang*/ btsas pa za ba rnams dang*/ srog 'phrog pa rnams dang*/ lhag ma za ba rnams dang*/ gtor ma za ba rnams dang*/ phreng ba za ba rnams dang*/ dri za ba rnams dang*/ bdug pa za ba rnams dang*/ me tog za ba rnams dang*/ 'bras bu za ba rnams dang*/ lo tog za ba rnams dang*/ sbyin sreg za ba rnams dang*/ rnag za ba rnams dang*/ phyi sa za ba rnams dang*/ gcin 'thung ba rnams dang*/ mchil ma 'thung ba rnams dang*/ skyug pa za ba rnams dang*/ snabs za ba rnams dang*/ ngar snabs za ba rnams dang*/ mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang*/ stor khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba rnams la sogs te bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad las slob ma rnams dang sems can thams cad srung du gsol/

oṃ hūm̐ ṣṭoṃ bandha bandha rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarba sa twāṃ shtsa bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ gzhan yang rims nyin gcig pa rnams dang*/ nyin gnyis pa rnams dang*/ nyin gsum pa rnams dang*/ nyin bzhi pa rnams dang*/ nyin bdun pa rnams dang*/ rtag pa'i rims rnams dang*/ rims mi bzad pa rnams dang*/ 'byung po'i rims rnams dang*/ rlung las gyur pa rnams dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa rnams dang*/ bad kan las gyur pa rnams dang*/ 'dus pa las gyur pa la sogs te rims nad thams cad dang*/ klad pa na ba rnams bsal du gsol/ gzhogs phyed na ba dang*/ yi ga 'chus pa dang*/ mig nad dang*/ sna nad dang*/ kha nad dang*/ mgul nad dang*/ snying nad dang*/ lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang*/ rna ba na ba dang*/ so na ba dang*/ snying na ba dang*/ klad pa na ba dang*/ rtsib logs na ba dang*/ rgyab na ba dang*/ lto ba na ba dang*/ rked pa na ba dang*/ chu so na ba dang*/ brla na ba dang*/ rje ngar na ba dang*/ lag pa na ba dang*/ rkang pa na ba dang*/ yan lag na ba dang*/ nying lag na ba rab tu bsal du gsol/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad las slob ma rnams dang sems can thams cad srung du gsol/ oṃ hūm̐ ṣṭoṃ bandha bandha rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarba sa twāṃ shtsa bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ gzhan gyis byas pa'i rig sngags ngan pa thams cad dang*/ gdon thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// kun du rgyus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// tshangs pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// dbang phyug chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// srid med kyi bus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// nam mkha' lding dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// nag po chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// ma mo'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// mi'i thod pa can gyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// rgyal bar byed pa dang*/

sbrang rtsir byed pa dang don kun grub pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// sring mo bzhis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// bhṛṅge ri ti dang dga' byed dbang phyug dang tshogs kyi bdag po dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// dge sbyong gcer bus byas pa'i rigs sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// dge sbyong mgo reg gis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// dgra bcom pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// 'dod chags dang bral bas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// lag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// pho nya dang pho nya mo dang bran pho dang bran mos byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// drang srong gi tshogs thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// mi 'phrod pa za ba'i bdag pos byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// mdor na gzhan gyi rig sngags dang*/ rbod gtong dang*/ byad ka dang phur ka la sogs pa'i gnod pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs par rdo rje slob ma rnams dang sems can thams cad srung du gsol/ oṃ hūm̐ ṣṭoṃ bandha bandha rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarba sa twāṃ shtsa bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ bum pa'i kha rgyan gyis bum chu 'thor ba'i tshul bya zhing*/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje yangs pa chen mos sems can gang su dag rdo rje slob mas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad la sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gdug pa dang gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/

drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ srog 'phrog pa rnams dang*/ gnod par sems pa thams cad las srung du gsol/ rig sngags chen mo 'di grub par mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje yangs pa chen mo sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad mas/ phyogs thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba dang phyag rgya'i tshogs thams cad kyis bdag dang slob ma 'di dag gi srog 'phrog cing gnod par sems pa'i rig sngags bcing du gsol/ mtshams bcing du gsol/ tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ kha se me kha se me/ bai ra bai ra/ so me so me/ shānte shānte/ dānte dānte/ bi ṣa de bi ṣa de/ bi re bi re/ badzra dha rī nī/ bandha bandha ni/ badzra pā ṇi phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ druṃ ṣṭoṃ phaṭa/ hūm̐ druṃ bandha phaṭa/ ma ma rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ sarba dur laṃ ghi te bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba duṣṭekṣi te bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba dzwa re bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba bha ye bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba u pa dra be bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba u pa sarge bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba kri te karma ṇi ka kho rde bhyaḥphaṭa/ ki ra ṇa be ta ḍe bhyaḥphaṭa/ tsitstsha pre sha ka duṣatstsha rdi te bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba du bhukte bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba tirthi ke bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba shra ma ṇe bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba pā ta ke bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba bi dya dha re bhyaḥphaṭa/ dza ya ka ra madhu ka ra sarba artha sā dha ke bhyo bidyā tsarye bhyaḥphaṭa/ tsa tur bhyo bha gī nī bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba kau mā rī badzra ku landha ri bidyā tsarye bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba ma hā pra tyaṃ gi ra bhyaḥphaṭa/ badzra shriṃ kha la pra tyaṃ gi ra rā dzā ya phaṭa/ badzra pā ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣṇī ṣa a na le/ a wa lo ki te/ murdha na te dzo rā se/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la/ dha ka dha ka dha ra dha ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ tshindha tshindha/ binda binda/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣṇī ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang slob ma rnams dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong ba dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad dang*/ yams kyi nad dang*/ 'tshe ba dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ nad 'go ba dang*/ 'khrug pa dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba dang*/ bkra mi shis pa la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar mdzad du gsol/ srung du gsol/ rdo rje'i rigs bye ba khrag khrig brgyad cu rtsa bzhis kyang 'di rnams la bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba bar mdzad du gsol/ hūm̐ ma ma hūm̐ ni swā hā/ bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ zhes bde legs su byed pa'i tshig dang bcas pa gsung zhing dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chu rgyun des spyi bo nas mar zhugs te lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang*/ nad dang gdon dang bgegs dang*/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad sangs kyis dag bcom ldan 'das ma'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid can du byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa bya ste de ni chu'i dbang yin/ cod paṇa gyi dbang gi slad du/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ thal mo sbyar ba bkan pa las// mdzub mo gnyis ni cung zad dgug /'di ni de bzhin gshegs rigs la// dam tshig phyag rgyar shes par bya// zhes pa ltar slob dpon gyis lag pa thal mo sbyar ba bkan pa las mdzub mo gnyis cung zad brkyang ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi phyag rgya spyi bor gtugs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tota bha wa badzra a bhi ṣitstsha hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas khyed rnams kyi spyi bor phyag mtshan 'khor lo'i rnam pa'i rgyas btab par mos pa mdzod/ de la oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs lngas mchod/ phyi ma 'di yig cha 'ga' zhig tu mi 'byung yang*/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ chu yi dbang bskur cod paṇa dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags// zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi dbang gi dngos gzhi yin pas ma chad pa gal che'o// mtha' rten du 'byor pa thob par bya ba'i phyir/

bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad sbyin par spro na/ tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dbang gi skabs ltar bya zhing*/ gal te ma grub kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur zhes kyang gsung ngo*// de dag brtan pa'i slad du/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pas me tog gi char 'bebs shing mgrin gcig tu bkra shis kyi cho ga byas par mos te/ ston mchog dam pa la sogs pa bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod pa'i mthar rdo rje slob ma rnams spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod do// de rnams kyis dbang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ dbang gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig la bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyis dam tshig bsdus te 'dzin par khas blangs nas/ dbang rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal phul/ lus dang longs spyod thams cad slob dpon la 'bul/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ der nas brtsams te sogs brjod de/ de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar po can ma lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba gsan pa yin pas rang dang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// ces bya ba la sogs pas dge ba bsngos nas slob ma rang gnas su gtang ngo*// gsum pa mjug gi bya ba la/ mchod pa kha gsos te byin gyis brlabs nas/ dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod byas la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ bzod par gsol zhing grub na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ ma grub na yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ras bris yin na/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sogs nas su pra tiṣṭha badzre swā hā'i bar gyis brtan bzhugs bya/

rdul tshon yin na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyis rten dang brten pa'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim zhes brjod cing*/ lha'i mtshan ma nas rdul tshon blangs te rang gzhan gyi mgo bor gzhag la/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dngos grub stsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ a kā ro brjod la rdul tshon rnams mtha' nas phyags te/ rin po che'i snod du blugs la/ mchod pa dang bcas te rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chur dor/ thig rjes 'o ma'am dri bzang gi chus bsrubs la/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas te/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// 'dir smras pa/ ston mchog zas gtsang sras kyi dge mtshan gtsug /mthing skra g.yas su 'khyil las 'phos pa'i bka'// mthu stobs thogs med yon tan mi zad pas// bsam kun rdzogs pa'i gtsug tor gdugs dkar can// der bstan bcu bdun lha yi grong khyer du// skal bzang dbang bskur cho ga 'phags bod kyi// gzhung lugs dag byed yongs btung brgyud pa'i rim// drang srong zhal sgo las brgyud zil dngar rgyun// bzod dka' 'byung gdon chu srin glal ba'i khar// nyon mongs bro 'tshal rlabs kyis g.yeng dus 'dir// phyir bzlog zhi dang srung skyob mi bslu ba'i// rten gling dpung gi bsngags pa 'di la rdzogs// ma brtags dpe tshogs gang bklag dbang bskur du// rlom pas dpyad gsum dag pa'i tshul 'di la// 'khyog gtam dmod pas 'dor bar mi byed na// gsang chen bstan pa'i rgyan du mi 'gyur ci// lhag bsam 'od brgyas legs byas gangs kyi ri// bzhu ba'i chu klung rgyal bstan snying po'i mtsho// ches cher rgyas par rigs sngags 'chang gi bya// grangs med bshad sgrub dbyangs snyan len par shog /ces de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can ma'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di ni/

dam pa snga mas mdzad pa'i yi ge rjod byed 'doms ches pas/ las dang po pa rnams kyis tshul bzhin lag tu lon par mi 'gyur ba'i rgyun 'byams pa spang ba'i slad du/ mkhas btsun bla ma drung pa bstan 'dzin phun tshogs pa'i gsung gi bskul ba'i ngor/ snye mdo shākya dpal gyis mdzad pa'i yi ge la gzhir byas/ paṇḍi ta shū rāṅga barm+ma dang*/ bi ma la mi tra dang*/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che la sogs pa'i gsung rab rnams la 'dris par dpyad cing nyams su blang bde bar/ rje btsun e waṃ pa brgyud par bcas pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par sbyar ba 'gro ba rnams la phan thogs par gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
